purpose: Exact contract for the build-only manifest of the four singleton-safety helper and focus-fixture L0 members.

generated_manifest.unknown_key_rule: Every generated-manifest object rejects unknown or missing keys. Arrays whose order is fixed reject reordering, duplication, omission, and addition.
generated_manifest.serialization: One RFC 8785 canonical JSON object with no leading or trailing bytes and no trailing LF.
generated_manifest.nondeterminism_rule: The generated manifest contains no timestamp, duration, random identifier, temporary path, expanded repository path, account-home path, environment value, inode, device number, process id, or signature creation time.

manifest_contract_shape.sha256: SHA-256 of the exact build-manifest-contract.json source bytes

value_domains.logical_path: nonempty repo-relative UTF-8 path using slash separators, with no empty, dot, or dot-dot component, no leading slash, no home shorthand, and at most 512 UTF-8 bytes
value_domains.compiler_version: nonempty printable ASCII string of at most 128 bytes, containing the compiler's normalized first --version line and no path, newline, timestamp, or host identity
value_domains.compiler_argv: array of 1 through 32 nonempty printable ASCII strings, each at most 256 bytes; argv[0] is xcrun, argv[1] is clang or swiftc matching compiler.family; every source or output argument is its exact repo-relative logical path; no expanded path, environment expansion, response file, temporary path, timestamp, or nondeterministic token is allowed
value_domains.bundle_id: JSON null for helper members; otherwise the exact member_definitions bundle_id

member_rules: generated_manifest.members is an array of exactly four member objects in generated_manifest.member_order
Each member has exactly generated_shapes.member_exact_keys and its logical_id selects exactly one member_definitions entry
contract has exactly generated_shapes.contract_exact_keys; its logical_source_id equals the selected definition and sha256 is recomputed from those exact repo bytes
sources is ordered exactly as source_logical_ids, has no duplicate, and every entry has exactly generated_shapes.source_exact_keys with a recomputed exact-byte SHA-256
compiler has exactly generated_shapes.compiler_exact_keys and matches the selected compiler_family and value_domains bounds
artifact has exactly generated_shapes.artifact_exact_keys; logical_path equals artifact_logical_path, kind is mach-o-executable, and sha256 is recomputed after all linking and signing

plist is JSON null for helper members; for fixture members it has exactly generated_shapes.plist_exact_keys, its two logical paths equal the selected definition, both hashes are recomputed, and source_sha256 equals artifact_sha256

bundle_id is JSON null for helper members and equals the selected definition for fixture members; the copied artifact plist must independently decode to that exact identifier and to executable name FocusFixture

codesign has exactly generated_shapes.codesign_exact_keys; scope is artifact-executable; mode none requires status unsigned, while linker-ad-hoc or explicit-ad-hoc requires status valid after verification of the final artifact bytes
composite has exactly generated_shapes.composite_exact_keys and exactly repeats the selected definition's domain, order, and composite_digests.formula; it records no computed composite digest
cross_member_rules: The generated manifest's single top-level target object applies to all four members because one generated manifest describes one native build cell
The primary and secondary artifact SHA-256 values are identical and equal the hash of one final signed FocusFixture executable copied byte-for-byte into both bundles
The primary and secondary compiler objects are byte-for-byte equal
The primary and secondary contract hashes and Swift source hashes are identical
The two fixture plist source hashes differ, their artifact hashes equal their corresponding source hashes, and their bundle identifiers differ
No object file, library, bundle directory, plist, contract, source, or generated manifest becomes a fifth L0 member

composite_digests.logical_part_shape: Each entry is exactly the two-element array [logical-part-id, sha256], where the id is the corresponding value in member_definitions.composite_logical_part_order and the digest is recomputed from that logical part's exact bytes.

part_resolution.build-manifest: exact generated-manifest bytes after generated_manifest and every member rule validate
part_resolution.primary-info-plist: exact Primary-Info.plist source bytes, equal to the final copied plist bytes
part_resolution.secondary-info-plist: exact Secondary-Info.plist source bytes, equal to the final copied plist bytes
part_resolution.final-executable: selected final artifact bytes after signing

composite_digests.output_rule: The computed digest populates only the selected existing L0 input-digest member. It is not stored in the generated manifest.

self_verification: The build-manifest contract is a source input identified by generated_manifest.manifest_contract and is hashed into that field.
The generated manifest is a separate generated byte object at logical_paths.generated_manifest; it never contains its own SHA-256.
All four members whose three existing contracts name build-manifest hash the finalized generated-manifest bytes only after exact-schema and artifact verification.

No computed L0 composite digest is stored in the generated manifest, so no digest depends recursively on a field containing itself. Including the same generated manifest as a logical part of all four members intentionally couples their composite digests to one exact native build cell; rebuilding any artifact changes the generated manifest and therefore all four composite digests.

A verifier needs only the repository source objects, the four final executable artifacts, the two final plist copies, this contract, and the generated manifest; compiler execution is not trusted as a hash witness.

contract_alignment.result_template_rule: The outer encoding follows result-template.json digest_encoding with the exact listed frozen-input domain and one 0x00 separator.
contract_alignment.foreground_and_fixture_rule: The independent-foreground-helper and both focus-fixture orders exactly match their current contracts and include the generated build manifest.
contract_alignment.process_contract_rule: The independent-process-helper order exactly matches its current contract: contract, C source, generated build manifest, and final executable, encoded as ordered [logical-part-id, sha256] pairs under the frozen-input domain with one 0x00 separator.
